title: Long mature freeform locs
caption: Notice the irregular root structure, naturally varied loc thickness, loose texture around the roots, and long organic silhouette.
patternDescription: The locs emerge without a uniform parting grid and vary visibly in diameter, with loose coily texture and irregular joining around the crown and roots.
lengthDescription: Mature locs extend well beyond the shoulders, with individual sections reaching different lengths and forming an intentionally uneven perimeter.
